verdicts_or_reports.field: todo.txt "Add completion date" setting / done prefix
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Settings > todo.txt > "Add completion date" unchecked, marking a task done should use the done prefix without a completion date, e.g. "x Pay rent pri:A".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: A completion date is still inserted even though "Add completion date" is unchecked: the line becomes "x 2026-11-14 Pay rent pri:A".
steps: Open More > Settings > todo.txt and uncheck "Add completion date".
Go to Files and open todo.txt.
Place the cursor on the line "(A) Pay rent".
Tap the "Toggle done" button in the editor action bar.
Observe the resulting line still contains today's completion date.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Editor text after pressing "Replace (1)" in the Search / Replace dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Only the matched text should be replaced: the document should become "(A) Fee rent" (unchanged apart from Pay→Fee).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The replacement is applied but an extra line containing today's date is appended: the document becomes "(A) Fee rent" followed by "2026-11-14 ".
steps: Open todo.txt (content "(A) Pay rent") in the editor.
Tap the Search toolbar button, then tap REPLACE in the "Search documents" dialog.
In the "Search / Replace" dialog enter "Pay" as Search for and "Fee" as Replace with.
Observe the editor: the replacement is made but an extra date line is appended.
